title: Quarantine questionable numeric provenance
description:
## Outcome
Quarantine questionable numeric provenance. The behaviour is available through the Infrastructure production path described below, with the named acceptance cases passing.

## Context
Implements §§1, 10–13 of DNA_CALC_REIMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, within Bootstrap checkpoint — independent lanes, CI and evidence safety. Own only Infrastructure files for this task; consume prerequisite APIs rather than editing another library. Production route: cargo xtask / calcctl; call the same exported library entrypoints as the applications.

## Do
Trace the provenance of OxFunc/crates/oxfunc_core/src/excel_numeric/ without consulting leaked or disassembled sources. x87.rs (890 lines, 21 asm! blocks) states that its EXP/LN/LOG/POWER sequences follow fpw32/tran/i386/87tran.asm and the 87disp.asm control word from the NT CRT source tree, while its ATAN path cites W111 black-box witnesses; mod.rs dispatches x86_64 versus portable; tables.rs with gen_tables.py, gammaln.rs, research.rs and x87_excel_ground_truth.tsv need a per-file disposition. Keep questionable code out of the new tree. Retain an independent black-box witness set with acquisition provenance; create a reviewed disposition for each candidate module. Clearing a comment is not clearance.
Add the named acceptance tests to this package's acceptance suite and register their exact names in its local acceptance manifest. Keep imported-source blob IDs and any changed semantic witnesses in the migration record. All proposed commands become real repository commands through infra-m0.3; a zero-test run is a failure.

## Port from
OxFunc/crates/oxfunc_core/src/excel_numeric/x87.rs: exp, pow_direct, atan and the fyl2x_fn expansion are QUARANTINED, not port sources until provenance clearance. OxFunc/crates/oxfunc_core/src/excel_numeric/ is a discovery location only. Use independent public-ISA/black-box witnesses for replacement code.

## Acceptance
```text
cargo xtask accept --id infra-m0.5 --platform windows --require-all
cargo xtask accept --id infra-m0.5 --platform linux --require-all
```
- `infra_m0_5__quarantine_gate`: A source manifest entry marked unresolved or tainted cannot enter the release source allowlist.
- `infra_m0_5__independent_witness`: Every retained numeric witness links to black-box acquisition metadata and no quarantined implementation is used to generate expected bits.
The acceptance runner must verify every named case actually executed and retain the machine-readable receipt. Assertions compare observable outputs, operation effects or independently instrumented calls, not a success flag assigned by the implementation itself.

## Platforms
Windows and Linux for repository/tooling execution. Artifacts produced here are consumed by wasm/browser CI; this bead does not imply running a native CLI inside wasm.

## Out of scope
Other command/function families and performance tuning. Do not add a second evaluator, a tree reference language, platform-specific code to portable libraries, or a hidden fallback. Any missing prerequisite requires an explicit dependent bead, not a local substitute.
notes:
Provisional plan ID: infra-m0.5. Native export preserves this ID; acceptance command IDs and test names use the same stable plan identity.

Handover from infra-m0.4 (2026-10-14): the source manifest lists, per catalogue function, the quarantined excel_numeric helpers its implementation module uses (196 of 526 functions; field quarantined_helpers). OxFunc smart-fuzzer research tools (calc_graph_racer, pmt_ppmt_local_eval, w111/complex_kernel_probe) enable oxfunc_core's research-x87 feature and call excel_exp and excel_ln (for example race_rate.rs:92); infra-m0.4 records all 911 files of those packages as quarantine_derived (`--lookup` exits 3 for them), and this bead gives them a disposition.
Also from infra-m0.4 round 2: 51 port inputs call oxfunc_core's quarantined excel_numeric dispatcher (for example functions/atan.rs -> excel_numeric/mod.rs:637 -> x87::atan_reduced); the manifest lists them per function as quarantined_helpers. The *-production-replay.json evidence files pinned as corpus hold "actual" values computed through legacy code that dispatches via excel_numeric (plan section 5.2: generated descendants are quarantined), and the w111-broad-20260929 evidence that dc-1c6a (the include follow-up) pins may too. This bead decides those dispositions.

Sharpened at claim (2026-10-14):
- Scope: the seven files of OxFunc/crates/oxfunc_core/src/excel_numeric/ at the pinned commit 6fca3518 (x87.rs, mod.rs, tables.rs, gen_tables.py, gammaln.rs, research.rs, x87_excel_ground_truth.tsv). Also the inputs migration/source-manifest.json marks quarantine_derived (911 files of the smart-fuzzer research tools that enable research-x87), the 196 catalogue functions whose implementation modules call the quarantined helpers (field quarantined_helpers), and the evidence classes named in the handover above (the *-production-replay.json corpus files and the w111-broad-20260929 evidence).
- Reading rule: provenance is traced from file headers, provenance comments, the OxFunc commit history of these paths (`git log` read-only at the pinned commit) and OxFunc's own docs. The algorithm bodies of the quarantined x87 paths (exp, pow_direct, atan, the fyl2x expansion) are not read for their behaviour. No leaked, decompiled or disassembled source is consulted. A cleared header comment is not clearance.
- Dispositions are recorded in a reviewed, committed file, migration/numeric-provenance.json: per candidate module or evidence class, one of cleared, tainted or unresolved, with the reason and the quoted header or commit evidence. `cargo xtask pin-sources` reads it, so the manifest carries each disposition and `--lookup` prints it. A quarantined or quarantine_derived input stays out of every port count until it is cleared.
- The release source allowlist is migration/release-source-allowlist.json, generated by `cargo xtask pin-sources` from the manifest and the dispositions, never by hand. It holds only inputs whose disposition admits copying into product code. infra_m0_5__quarantine_gate proves, on fixtures, that an entry marked unresolved or tainted cannot enter it: the generator excludes it, and a hand-added entry is rejected by the check that `cargo xtask accept` runs.
- Witnesses: retain a small independent black-box witness set in the repository (under migration/witnesses/), each file with acquisition metadata: source blob, how it was acquired (an Excel capture with build and settings where known), and generator. A witness whose acquisition is unknown, or whose expected values came from a quarantined implementation (for example values computed through x87.rs or gen_tables.py, or the production-replay "actual" values), is not retained as a witness; it is recorded as excluded with its reason. infra_m0_5__independent_witness checks that every retained witness links to black-box acquisition metadata and that no retained witness names a quarantined generator.
- The cases run from committed files on both platforms. Where they re-verify a retained witness against its pinned blob, the Linux run reads the legacy repositories through DNACALC_LEGACY_ROOT=/mnt/c/Work/DnaCalc, as infra-m0.4's cases do. Legacy repositories stay read-only.
Ruling after round 2 (2026-10-15, orchestrator; corrects the round-2 instruction to make the callers rule transitive): plan sections 1.1 and 12 quarantine derived material and derived descendants, which is a property of a file's content, not of its call graph. A file is tainted when its own content cites, copies, embeds or was changed by tainted material: a CRT-chain or C-runtime citation, a copy of a tainted function, an include of a tainted or unresolved file, a test value computed through a tainted chain, or a change by a commit the record marks tainted. It is unresolved when that cannot be established. A file that only calls a tainted or unresolved module, in its own repository or another, keeps its own disposition and carries a calls_quarantined list. The release allowlist admits it only with that list, and a port bead ports it against clean replacements of every listed module. Cross-repository and run-time edges are recorded at crate level and counted; dc-4uy4 owns resolving them to files. dc-2203 owns the file-by-file clearance of the numeric-callers class, the excluded tests and the ground-truth table; dc-0huc owns making the witness selection a repository command; dc-1c6a owns all five unread include inputs.
Handover (2026-10-15, after the third implementer round): the build commit carries migration/numeric-provenance.json (dispositions per module, class and rule under the content-derivation ruling, reviewed by an independent agent, with owner confirmation of the five cleared witness sources pending), migration/numeric-provenance-review-2026-10-15.json, migration/release-source-allowlist.json, five minimized witness selections under migration/witnesses/ (about 56 KB, each compared row by row with the capture runner's own retention) and the numeric-provenance check of `cargo xtask accept`. infra_m0_5__quarantine_gate and infra_m0_5__independent_witness pass on Windows. The round-3 judge left two blocking findings, now owned by the prerequisite dc-m33w, which holds this bead open: (1) the tainted-commit list must be derived by a stated rule and checked at accept time (as a conservative data step the orchestrator added the 55 commits the rule finds, so the 8 files the judge named exit 5); (2) ffcb9a77 needs an independent review, and listing it today makes the witness generators unresolved, so functions/asin.rs, acot.rs and atan.rs remain admitted with calls_quarantined (lookup exit 6) until that review. Linux has not been run yet; it runs at the close. Follow-up dc-qfqa holds the remaining round-3 findings.
close_reason:

The tainted-commit list is rule-derived (dc-m33w). migration/release-source-allowlist.json is generated by `cargo xtask pin-sources` and admits 478 inputs, 165 only with a calls_quarantined list. Five minimized live-Excel witness selections (migration/witnesses/, about 56 KB) are checked row by row against the capture runner's retention through hash continuity. `cargo xtask accept` runs the numeric-provenance check as its seventh architecture check. Owner confirmation of the five cleared witness sources is pending. Commits 6c579a2 (build) and 80a3733 (dc-m33w), pushed.
Evidence: Windows at 80a3733, accept-receipts/infra-m0.5/windows.json: "ACCEPT passed infra_m0_5__quarantine_gate (package xtask, exit code 0)", "ACCEPT passed infra_m0_5__independent_witness (package xtask, exit code 0)", RESULT passed, architecture checks 7/7, exit code 0. Linux (WSL, clone at 80a3733, DNACALC_LEGACY_ROOT=/mnt/c/Work/DnaCalc), accept-receipts/infra-m0.5/linux.json: both cases passed, RESULT passed, architecture checks 7/7, exit code 0.
